name: create-master
title_zh: 把高僧大德的讲学风格蒸馏成可对话的 AI 导师
tagline_zh: 想跟虚云、弘一那样的大德请教，却无缘亲炙？这个 skill 用佛教原典训练角色，让 AI 以他们的口吻和见地。
tagline_en: Want to learn from masters like Xuyun or Hongyi but can't meet them? This skill builds AI mentors from Buddhist.
desc_en: 基于佛教经典文献，生成特定高僧大德的 AI 教学角色
why_zh: 不是套皮聊天，而是从原典抽取义理与机锋，按人物生平校准应答尺度，让角色有戒律感，不越格、不戏说。
why_en: Not a chatbot costume—it mines doctrine and repartee from source texts, calibrates responses to each master's biography, keeping.
limit_zh: 只认汉传佛教高僧且需有足够文献支撑；无原典依据的提问会拒绝回答。不覆盖藏传、南传，也不做经义考据或学术论证。
limit_en: Only Chinese Buddhist masters with sufficient textual sources; questions without scriptural basis are declined. Excludes Tibetan/Theravada, no.
